fields.description: On/Off drive power state. All ECUs related to drive are ready/powered. Typically means brake pedal is pressed + key authenticated or driving.
The non-detailed charge state of the vehicle. See DetailedChargeState for detailed charge state data.
Indicates BMS is fully charged.
The speed of the vehicle is miles per hour.
The number of miles the vehicle has driven. Beginning with firmware version 2025.2.6, the minimum delta for Odometer is set to 0.1 by default.
Voltage measured on the battery side of the HV contactors.
Current measured at the HV contactors of the HV battery.
The usable state of charge of the vehicle, as a percent of total battery capacity.
The state of the PCS's DCDC enable line.

Resistance between HV bus and chassis.

If GPS lock is acquired.
The orientation of the vehicle. 0 represents North, 90 represents East, etc.

The state of the high voltage interlock.
The amount of energy in kWh added during a charging session. This is measured at the battery. It can be relied upon for both AC and DC charging.
The kilowatts added during a DC charging session.
The amount of energy in kWh added during an AC charging session. This is measured from the charger. This field should be ignored during DC charging.
Total AC charger input power.
The state of charge at which charging will terminate, as a percentage of battery capacity.
Is a fast charger is present.
The estimated range of the vehicle given its current state of charge. Takes driving conditions into account.
The current range of the vehicle, assuming ideal conditions (speed, weather, etc).
The state of charge of the vehicle, as a percent of total battery capacity.

The number of hours until charging is complete. If the charge session is part of a trip, this is the time until ready to continue. Otherwise, this is time until the user set limit (specified by ChargeLimitSoc).
The time charging is scheduled to begin. Timestamp fields report incorrectly. Treating the reported value as Pacific Time will yield the date and time in the vehicle's timezone.
If a charge session is scheduled.
If the vehicle is preconditioning.
The mode for scheduled charging.
AC charger's sensed input line current.
If charging is enabled.
The number of phases available from the connected charger.
Indicates whether the charge port is in cold weather mode.
The requested amps to charge the vehicle.
The maximum available amps available to charge.
If the battery is actively heating itself. This may be done in cold weather or when preconditioning for supercharging. This field is not available on Pre-2021 Model S/X.
If the battery does not have enough power available to heat itself.
If the current supercharging session is part of a trip plan.

The total number of miles driven using Full Self-Driving since the Self-Driving statistics were reset.
